proven_defect: All three first/round/replacement sender loops wrote every variant of a union in sequence. After assigning StateValue, unused AbilityChange.CooldownRemaining=0 overwrote that same storage. Thus actual server Is_Dead=1 became wire Is_Dead=0. AuraAbilityID and remaining duration were similarly overwritten with zeros.

The ordinary-round sender also read update.State.ID without checking the union tag. A 1HP update or aura slot1 was misclassified as death; it cleared flags and event ordering. Genuine death and revival events also lost their native flags/turn regardless of state value.

Native26972/hotfix BattlePetState1 is Is_Dead with Flags8, so PetBattle::SetPetState emits the affected death update. Packet counterfactual uses pinned503fd969b sender and actual BattleRound::Write/ByteBuffer: IsDead1 becomes0 before repair.
